The [[Star Wars: Galaxy of Creatures (book)|''Star Wars: Galaxy of Creatures'' book]] depicts all episodes of ''[[Star Wars Galaxy of Creatures]]'' taking place a relatively short [[time]] apart. {{GoC|Porgs (Galaxy of Creatures)}} features [[porg]]s on [[Batuu]], a [[species]] that ''[[Star Wars: Tales from the Galaxy's Edge]]'' establishes were not present on the [[planet]] Batuu until the [[Resistance]] brought them there between the events of {{Film|VII}} and [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]]. Therefore, porgs must have been introduced to Batuu between those stories, which corresponds to [[34 ABY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'', meaning that the events of ''Star Wars Galaxy of Creatures'' take place during or after 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].<noinclude>
